import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert age from code to numeric
data['AlterVHundNum'] = pd.to_numeric(data['AlterVHundNum'], errors='coerce')

# Create a count of dog breeds
breed_counts = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

# Create a barplot of the top 10 dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.index, y=breed_counts.values, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert age from code to numeric
data['AlterVHundNum'] = pd.to_numeric(data['AlterVHundNum'], errors='coerce')

# Create a count of dog breeds
breed_counts = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

# Create a barplot of the top 10 dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.index, y=breed_counts.values, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
